generation_policy: Contract-gated: generated only for previously uncovered L2 features with a nonblank L2 what contract; contract contents are treated as provisionally correct per user instruction.

feature.description: Identifies and reconciles authorization, scope, time, cost, data, safety, policy, tool, environment, and output-format constraints with the user’s intended outcome.

contract.purpose_user_function: Compile authorization, scope, time, cost/resource, data, safety/policy, tool/environment, and output constraints into the plan and contracts.
contract.valid_inputs: User constraints, workspace binding, action policy, tool/runtime availability, resource limits, output format, write scopes, and command allowlists.
contract.expected_outputs: Requirements/contracts/DAG nodes with constraints, write scopes, gates, resource rules, stop rules, and explicit limitations.
contract.state_side_effects: Constrains executable graph nodes and allowed commands/writes; high-risk actions require approval or remain blocked.
contract.failure_rejection_behavior: Fails closed on illegal writes, disallowed commands, missing approvals, graph invalidity, or incompatible workspace/environment constraints.
contract.supported_boundaries_exclusions: Repository governance and action restrictions are concrete; cost and domain-specific policy tradeoff resolution may remain textual.
contract.success_evidence: `harness/lib/plan_validator.py::compile_and_stamp` validates graph, write scope and gate allowlists; `harness/lib/policy/action_policy.py` classifies approval-sensitive actions.
contract.granularity_atomic_contracts: Separate contracts for authorization, scope/write paths, time, resource/cost, data access, safety/policy, tool/runtime, format, and conflicting constraints.
